2609.04365.title: Ultrasound-Based Prediction of Cirrhosis Decompensation Using Large-Scale Computer Vision Models
2609.04365.paper_summary: Decompensation represents a critical transition in the course of cirrhosis, yet clinicians have limited non-invasive tools to reliably predict its onset. In this study, we propose a novel imaging-based approach that leverages large-scale computer vision models to analyze routine abdominal ultrasound images and extract predictive features beyond those captured by traditional laboratory-based risk scores. Ultrasound is widely available, low cost, and suitable for longitudinal surveillance, making it an attractive modality for scalable risk stratification and long-term follow-up. Our framework integrates automated ultrasound data processing with modern deep learning architectures to identify patients at high risk of decompensation prior to the occurrence of clinical deterioration. This non-invasive strategy offers a practical complement to existing clinical scoring systems and may enable earlier, more proactive management of patients with compensated cirrhosis.
2609.04365.paper_summary_zh: 去補償代表了肝硬化過程中的一個關鍵轉折點，但臨床醫生在可靠預測其發作方面的非侵入性工具有限。<lb/>在這項研究中，我們提出了一種新穎的基於影像的方法，利用大規模計算機視覺模型來分析常規腹部超聲影像，並提取超越傳統實驗室風險評分所捕捉的預測特徵。<lb/>超聲檢查廣泛可用、成本低廉，且適合進行長期監測，使其成為可擴展風險分層和長期隨訪的有吸引力的方式。<lb/>我們的框架將自動化超聲數據處理與現代深度學習架構相結合，以在臨床惡化發生之前識別高風險的去補償患者。<lb/>這種非侵入性策略為現有的臨床評分系統提供了實用的補充，並可能使補償性肝硬化患者的管理更早、更積極。
